pages.text: You pick your folk the first time you join. Each folk has two or three small gifts, one racial power on $(k:key.neoorigins.skill_1) with a long cooldown, and one light drawback.$(br2)The gifts are small next to your class and gear, and every class works with every folk. Pick the one you like.
Press $(k:key.neoorigins.view_info) to read your folk's powers in game.
